Product Overview

Bring a nutrient-dense, grain-free diet to your dog's bowl with this protein-packed complete and balanced meal, featuring Ocean Wise recommended wild-caught salmon, non-GMO fruits and veggies, and superfoods like pumpkin and coconut oil. Rich in omega-3 fatty acids and always free of corn, wheat, and soy, this 100% traceable recipe is formulated for optimal nutrition.

Great for: skin & coat, small & medium breed puppies, adult & senior dogs

Open Farm Satisfaction Guarantee for Online Orders

At Open Farm, we understand that trying new pet food can feel like a big leap — especially when it comes to your furry family member’s health and happiness. That’s why we’re excited to offer our 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee for first-time customers and existing customers looking to explore new recipes!

Love It or Your Money Back

We offer a 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee on eligible Open Farm recipes purchased through openfarmpet.com or authorized retailers. If you or your pet are not completely satisfied within 30 days (from delivery for openfarmpet.com orders or purchase for authorized retailers), we’ll make it right with a refund or exchange.

Refunds are issued back to the original payment method used at checkout; for openfarmpet.com orders we can process your refund directly, while retailer purchases follow the retailer’s return policy (and we’re happy to help if you need guidance).

Refund eligibility is limited to one (1) refund per SKU (item) per customer or household; proof of donation may be requested before a refund is issued, and approval is subject to purchase verification and at the discretion of our Pet Parent Experience Team.

Need help choosing? We’re here for you

Before you place your order, our Feeding Experts are here to help you find the best fit for your pet. Tell us a little about your pet, and we’ll guide you to the right options so you can choose with confidence. Reach out to us anytime!

Feeding Guidelines

Review the feeding guideline to find the appropriate feeding amount based on your dog’s weight and activity level.

Suitable For: Small & Medium Breed Puppies
Suitable for small and medium breed puppies - less than 70lbs when fully-grown.
Puppies typically include dogs up to one year old in small and medium breeds and up to two years old for large breeds.
, Adult Dogs, Senior Dogs
Weight(lbs): Less Active Cups/Day: More Active Cups/Day:
10 lbs or less ¼-½ ¼-¾
10-20 lbs ½-1 ¾-1¼
20-30 lbs 1-1¼ 1¼-1¾
30-40 lbs 1¼-1½ 1¾-2¼
40-60 lbs 1½-2 2½-3
60-80 lbs 2-2¾ 3-3¾
80-100 lbs 2¾-3¼ 3¾-4½
Weight(lbs): 1 to 6 Months: 6 to 12 Months :
Up to 10 lbs 1½ 1
10-20 lbs 2½ 1⅔
20-30 lbs 3⅜ 2¼
30-40 lbs 4¼ 2¾
40-50 lbs 5 3⅓
50-60 lbs 5¾ 3¾
70-80 lbs 7⅛ 4¾

Add ¼ cup for every 10 lbs over 100 lbs.
Gestation: Increase 25% - 50%
Lactation: Feed free-choice.
We recommend storing in the original bag. Once opened, we recommend feeding our Dry Recipes within two months for the freshest flavor.

Ingredients

This ingredient list reflects from our most recent lot. To view sourcing information about your specific bag, check out our transparency tool

Ingredient

Origin

Wild-caught Pacific salmon

United States, Alaska

Salmon is high in quality protein and contains long-chain omega-3 fatty acids like EPA and DHA. Our salmon is wild-caught in the North Pacific Ocean, is sustainable, wild-caught, and recommended by Ocean Wise.

Garbanzo Beans (Chickpeas)

United States, North Dakota

Chickpeas are a fiber-rich legume and a great source of protein, iron, copper, zinc, and magnesium. Our chickpeas are non-GMO.

Whitefish Meal

United States, Washington

Whitefish is a great source of protein and omega-3 fatty acids. Fish meal, fish with the water removed, is a concentrated source of amino acids needed for healthy muscles. There are many species of whitefish available. We source primarily hake or the freshest whitefish based on seasonal availability. Our whitefish meal is sustainable, wild-caught, and recommended by Ocean Wise.

Field Peas

United States, North Dakota

Peas contain protein, fat, fiber, and carbohydrates for energy. Peas also supply vitamin A, vitamin C, thiamine, riboflavin, and niacin. They are a great source of calcium, iron, phosphorus, and potassium for overall nutritional health. Our peas are non-GMO.

Herring Meal

Mexico

Herring Meal contains high amounts of protein and omega-3, specifically DHA and EPA. The meal version of herring is the fish with the water removed. Our herring meal is sustainable, wild-caught, and recommended by Ocean Wise.

Red Lentils

United States, North Dakota

Red Lentils are a good source of dietary fiber, protein, and B-vitamins. Our red lentils are non-GMO.

Coconut Oil

Philippines / Indonesia

Coconut oil contains medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), it is an excellent palatant and is high in lauric acid. Coconut oil can be preserved with mixed tocopherols.

Green Lentils

United States, North Dakota

Green lentils are a good source of dietary fiber, protein, and B-vitamins. Our lentils are non-GMO.

Coconut Meal

Papau New Guinea

Coconut meal is a good source medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), protein, and fiber. It is derived from the defatted meat of the coconut fruit.

Pumpkin

Honduras

Pumpkin is a good source of vitamins A and C, minerals like potassium, antioxidants, fiber and beta-carotene. Our pumpkin in non-GMO.

Natural Flavor (yeast)

United States, Missouri

Natural flavor is a natural ingredient derived from non-GMO yeast.

Carrots

United States, California

Carrots are a good source of vitamin A from beta-carotene, bitamin B6, biotin, and fiber. Our carrots are non-GMO.

Sunflower Oil

United States, Minnesota

Sunflower oil is a great source of essential fatty acids, including Omega 6. It is used to help create the ideal fatty acid profile to support healthy skin and coat. Sunflower oil can be preserved with mixed tocopherols.

Apples

United States, Wisconsin

Apples are a good source of potassium, vitamin C and fiber. They also contain antioxidants including phytochemicals. Our apples are non-GMO.

Salt

United States, Kansas, Utah

Salt helps maintain the proper balance in the body as well as supporting healthy digestion. It is an essential nutrient made up of sodium and chloride with trace minerals required to maintain optimal pet health.

Cranberries

United States, Wisconsin

Cranberries are a good source of vitamin C, E, and K, manganese, antioxidants, and fiber. Our cranberries are non-GMO.

Flaxseed

United States, North Dakota

Flaxseed is a good source of vitamins B1 (thiamin) and B6 (pyridoxine), minerals like magnesium and phosphorus, omega-3 fatty acids, and high in fiber. Flaxseed is used in our products to help balance the dietary omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acid ratio required to support a healthy skin and coat.

Dried Chicory Root

Belgium

Chicory root is a natural source of insoluble fiber, and inulin, a soluble fiber which serves as a prebiotic, feeding the gut bacteria to support gastrointestinal health. Our chicory root is non-GMO.

Vitamin E Supplement

Spain

Vitamin E is helps support healthy skin and circulatory health.

Vitamin A Supplement

Denmark / Poland

Vitamin A is a fat-soluble vitamin needed by pets to help support healthy vision, skin, bones, and other tissues in the body.

Niacin Supplement

Poland

Niacin is an essential vitamin. It helps support good digestive health. As a B vitamin, it also supports skin and coat health.

D-calcium Pantothenate

Poland

D-calcium pantothenate is an essential nutrient. It is involved in the metabolism of proteins, carbohydrates, and fats as well as the maintenance of healthy skin and coat.

Riboflavin Supplement

Poland

Riboflavin (B2) helps support the health of your pet and to support healthy skin and coat.

Thiamine Mononitrate

Poland

Thiamine mononitrate is essential to maintain optimal health in pets.

Vitamin B12 Supplement

Poland

Vitamin B12 is an important supplement needed by pets for energy production. B12 is also important for maintaining a healthy nervous system.

Pyridoxine Hydrochloride

Poland

Pyridoxine hydrochloride is important to support healthy skin and is involved in the production of hydrochloric acid to support healthy digestion.

Folic Acid

Poland

Folic acid is an essential nutrient for maintaining dogs and cats optimal health.

Salmon Oil

Norway

Salmon oil is a great source of omega-3 fatty acids, notably EPA and DHA.

Sun Cured Alfalfa

United States, Nebraska

Sun cured alfalfa is also called lucerne. It is a good source of Vitamin A, K, and E as well as calcium and potassium. It is also a good source of insoluble fiber to support proper digestive health.

Dicalcium Phosphate

United States, Iowa

Dicalcium phosphate provides calcium to support healthy bones and is used to balance the ratio of calcium and phosphorus to ensure ideal levels.

Choline Chloride

Choline chloride is important for the overall support of maintaining a healthy metabolism. It is needed to maintain optimal pet health.

Frequently
Asked
Questions

How is Open Farm's kibble different from other kibble options?

Our passion to Do Some Good® for animals and the planet translates to knowing your pet is getting the best nutrition possible – animal welfare certified meats raised without antibiotics or added hormones, sustainable seafood, non-GMO fruits and veggies, and more. Always without corn, wheat, soy, artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives.

We’ve always sourced meat certified to comprehensive animal welfare standards. We believe our approach to sourcing results in happier, healthier farm animals and higher quality meats in your pet’s bowl.

We're also committed to transparency and sharing everything pet parents need to know about what’s in their pet’s bowl. That’s why for every Open Farm recipe you will find the geographic origin of every ingredient, safety test results for each product, third-party certification details, and carbon emissions.

What if this recipe doesn't suit my dog's needs or preferences?

We've got you covered! We understand that trying new pet food can feel like a big leap — especially when it comes to your furry family member’s health and happiness. That’s why we’re excited to offer our 30-Day Satisfaction Guarantee for first-time customers and existing customers looking to explore new recipes!

Our 30-day satisfaction guarantee covers the full recommended transition period from your pet’s old food to their Open Farm new recipe, plus plenty of extra time to reach out to us to initiate a return if needed. If you or your pet isn’t completely satisfied for any reason, we’ll gladly provide a full refund or exchange for recipes purchased on OpenFarm.com within 30 days of delivery.

How do I know which kibble is right for my dog's needs?

We offer more options for dog parents than ever, from grain-free to oven-baked – and all life stages! Our Pet Parent Experience Team is here to assist you with any questions about selecting the right products for your pet’s unique dietary needs. Reach out to us anytime!

Each dog is unique, and our Ancient Grains kibble is a great option for those pet parents looking for a grain-inclusive, protein-packed complete and balanced meal. Single protein options great for sensitivities like lamb and venison, as well as dedicated formulas for puppies and small breeds, are available.

Pet parents looking for a grain-free diet can find protein-packed complete and balanced nutrition with our Grain-Free kibble. Single protein options great for sensitivities like lamb and venison, as well as dedicated formulas for puppies, seniors, and small breeds, are available.

Calling all meat lovers! RawMix packs a protein punch with multi-protein blends of bone broth and freeze coated kibble, boosted with bonus chunks of freeze dried raw. Ancestral nutrition inspired by the wild, this complete and balanced meal is offered in both grain- and legume-free and ancient grain options. Dedicated formulas for large breeds are available.

Our Goodbowl is oven-baked in small batches, a process that preserves both nutrients and flavor. It's a great entry point into trying Open Farm, with the 100% traceable and meticulously sourced ingredients pet parents love! We included wholesome grains like brown rice along with a variety of non-GMO fruits and veggies for a highly nutritious, digestible complete and balanced meal.

Our kibble for tailored needs is veterinarian formulated with functional ingredients that bring big benefits to your pet's bowl. Dedicated formulas for a healthy skin and coat, healthy weight, and digestive health are available.

What is fishmeal and why is it used in this recipe?

We'd love to share that we intentionally include fish meal in our dry kibble recipes, as they provide extra nutrition! Fish meal, fish with the water removed, is a concentrated source of amino acids needed for healthy muscles and is a highly concentrated source of animal protein! There are many species of whitefish available. We source primarily hake or the freshest whitefish based on seasonal availability. Our whitefish meal is sustainably sourced and always ocean-caught, never farmed.

We rely on AAFCO guidelines for all our formulation requirements. The protein named in the title of our Recipe makes up at minimum 25% of the recipe per their guidelines!
